assessment.boundary: Contradicted means an observed material violation of this obligation, not uncertainty, optional improvement or failure to prove universal behavior. Do not request CI output or a new runtime experiment unless the pinned assignment requires that record.
assessment.procedure: Compare the SAME run/condition/scenario and SAME field. An over-budget deal with correct=0 and violation=1 can be accurately recorded in both CSV and log. That is an experimental finding in prompt conditions, not a log mismatch. Summary equality does not prove event-derived counters; use the separate explicit event facts and raw records. Unselected logs in another part do not constitute missing records. A consolidated tool_result record can document both the call and its response when it identifies role, tool and negotiation. In particular, get_negotiation has only negotiation_id, so its identified response need not have a separate tool_call event label. No particular logging event vocabulary is required. Missing mutation arguments or unidentifiable calls still require review.

Buyer view of each seller proposal receives the exact required market notice, with raised=max(reserve,budget)+30. Compare the assembled sentence and exposure, not Python source formatting.

assessment.procedure: Count actual server-refused calls followed by a valid move in the same protocol turn. Explicit event facts are bounded markers, not proof of exhaustive coverage.
